question: 假设新颖性贡献率Proxy_Novelty(K)的估算：Proxy_Novelty(K) = 1 - Cosine_Similarity(Hypothesis_K, Hypothesis_Baseline)，其中Baseline为无检索生成的假设；实验数据显示K=3时Proxy≈0.15, K=5时Proxy≈0.22, K=10时Proxy≈0.23，表明K=5后边际收益递减
